overview.en:
Connect ONLYOFFICE’s official DocSpace MCP to work with files, folders, collaboration rooms and document workflows.

Locate files and review their contents in the connected workspace. Keep file identity and access context explicit when preparing a summary or organization plan.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
连接 ONLYOFFICE 官方 DocSpace MCP，处理文件、文件夹、协作空间与文档工作流。

在已连接工作区中定位文件并查看内容，准备摘要或整理方案时明确文件身份与访问范围。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Find the files for this project and summarize what each contains.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找这个项目的文件，并汇总各文件内容。

starterPrompts.en: Compare these two documents and list the substantive differences.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这两份文档，列出实质性差异。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a file organization plan for this project without moving files yet.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个项目准备文件整理方案，先不要移动文件。
